tests.name: 4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹
tests.assertion: test('4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(event,c){if(event==='beforeBattleStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.a.ailments['烧伤']=4;c.t.ailments['中毒']=4;}old.run(event,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4946/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[20085,10171,29455,29456,38538]});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.amount,2);for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29466,20085);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']>=r,r===3);}});

tests.name: 4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零

tests.name: 4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留
tests.assertion: test('4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});turn(s,38568,20309);turn(s,38554,20309);const n=sum(s),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.ok(n>=300);assert.equal(st.remainder,n%300);assert.equal(st.pendingControls,0);const statuses=Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments);assert.ok(statuses.length>0);for(const name of statuses)assert.ok(['麻痹','害怕','疲惫','睡眠','石化','冰封','焚烬','诅咒','感染','神游','空定'].includes(name),name);});

tests.name: 4950/2149有副位攻击真实忽略普通盾，副位空缺后盾正常承伤；命中附讨保留命名状态
tests.assertion: test('4950/2149有副位攻击真实忽略普通盾，副位空缺后盾正常承伤；命中附讨保留命名状态',()=>{for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=1000;if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,38554,20117);const events=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0);assert.ok(events.length);assert.equal(events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.hpLoss,0)>0,reserve);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149,reserve);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield===1000,reserve);}});

tests.assertion: test('4950/2149消逝移除整个精灵体力上限后不借副位恢复非法正HP，普通主位死亡仍由副位接替',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true}),f=s.fighters[0];E.STATUS_RULES.vanish(s,f,1);assert.equal(f.hp,0);assert.equal(f.stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2149].abilities.promote({a:f,t:s.fighters[1],round:1}),false);assert.equal(f.hp,0);assert.equal(f.soulState.vanished,true);});

tests.name: 4950/2149钺主位特殊攻击真实提升50%，面板攻击100不混入特攻计算；副位空缺不取消主位增伤
tests.assertion: test('4950/2149钺主位特殊攻击真实提升50%，面板攻击100不混入特攻计算；副位空缺不取消主位增伤',()=>{const plain=make({move:38554,index:-1}),normal=[];turn(plain,38554,20309);const base=sum(plain);for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spa,plain.fighters[0].stats.spa);if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,38554,20309);const amount=sum(s);assert.ok(Math.abs(amount-base*1.5)<=1,JSON.stringify({base,amount}));normal.push(amount);}assert.equal(normal[0],normal[1]);});

tests.name: 4950/2149已持有星皇之佑有副位不减回合、免异常及免弱，无副位按剩余3回合实际倒计时
